desc: Gun shots by modern armed soldiers. Extracted from a video () by a US Government agency, thus public domain. Note that while the video uploader may not be a soldier, the video material was made by an US Army soldier during duty. The extracted sfx were not edited and in this case the public domain still applies even when it's part of a video not made by an US army soldier on duty. Find many more military sounds in my military sounds pack, also located on Freesound. On FLAC and OGG Vorbis audio file formats. Contact me if you have interest in specific sounds for open source or commercial purpose.
